items.title: Ex-Medtronic CEO grades Nvidia board: 'About an F'
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi is joined by former Medtronic (MDT) CEO Bill George, who grades the Nvidia (NVDA) board's makeup, its handling of Jensen Huang's departure, and its succession plan.

items.title: What AI CEOs expect ahead of Anthropic's upcoming IPO
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirde Bosa and Ejaaz Ahamadeen are joined by Jesse Zhang, Decagon Co-Founder and CEO, and Cristóbal Valenzuela, Runway Co-Founder and Co-CEO at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest Conference. The panel discusses market volatility following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, the future of open-weight AI models, and what to expect ahead of Anthropic's upcoming IPO.

items.title: Nvidia's biggest challenge: Replacing Jensen Huang
items.summary: "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the story of the year: Jensen Huang stepping down as Nvidia (NVDA) CEO.  The hosts revisit key developments surrounding the leadership shake-up and examine what comes next for the AI chip giant. While Nvidia's operations will continue, the hosts discuss Huang's influence on the company's success and why replacing him as leader could prove challenging.

items.title: Nvidia stock slips as investors digest CEO exit, broader chip sector falls
items.summary: Nvidia stock declined on Friday as the rest of the chip sector also fell.

items.title: Lutnick agrees to testify before Congress as Republicans pile on the embattled Commerce secretary
items.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has reportedly agreed to testify before lawmakers next month as the spotlight on him grows harsher amid Nvidia's turmoil.

items.title: 10-Year Treasury yield spikes on hot inflation read, Nvidia leads chip stocks lower: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Stocks were mixed on Friday after a hotter-than-expected wholesale price index. Tech stocks declined as semiconductors retreated.

items.title: Cathie Wood on Nvidia's strengths in a post-Jensen Huang era
items.summary: Cathie Wood of ARK Investments tells Deirdre Bosa that Jensen Huang's exit is a shock but won't stop the AI movement, arguing that a deep bench of engineers sits behind "the Jensen show" and that competition, more than leadership, will decide Nvidia's market share. She walks through how ARK stress-tests Nvidia's share of the GPU market and why people, management and culture now matter more than ever.

items.title: What to make of Jensen Huang's resignation: AI Investing Panel
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman chats with SoFi (SOFI) chief market strategist Liz Thomas, Moor Insights & Strategy founder Patrick Moorhead, and EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss all things Nvidia (NVDA).
